about: Hell’s armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and stop the final destruction of humanity. The only thing they fear... is you.
The Deluxe Edition includes DOOM Eternal and the DOOM Eternal - Expansion Pack, containing both campaign expansions plus the Complete Cosmetics Pack and the Rip and Tear Pack.
summary: Become the Slayer in an epic campaign and stop the destruction of humanity.
